text.p: Sudanese Vice-President al-Zubeir Mohammad Saleh on Tuesday said Sudan had received Qatar's support for its unity and sovereignty, the official Qatar News Agency reported.
Saleh arrived in the Gulf Arab state on Tuesday as part of a tour to brief leaders on the military conflict in Sudan. He came from Syria after stops in Saudi Arabia, Egypt and Yemen.
Sudan's military government has called for mobilisation against what it says are attacks by troops of neighbours Eritrea and Ethiopia. Both states deny the charges.
Sudanese rebels said they launched the fighting to put pressure on the Khartoum government and bring about a popular uprising.
Rebel leader John Garang said on Tuesday his forces killed 300 government troops in a battle south of the key eastern town of Damazin.
